name: Fallen Sky Lords
label: Quest
description: Fallen Sky Lords: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We got them held prisoner, traveler. I'm talking about their Wing Commanders. It was a furious battle in the skies but they finally fell! Unfortunately, our best pilots were shot down in a counterattack against Frostwolf Keep. You gotta find out what happened to them.
Search Tower Point West and Frostwolf Keep. These were their last known locations. Search these areas thoroughly.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Anything I would care to hear?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Unbelievable! You did free them, right? Right??? Well at the very least we know where they were held.
